name: LUFFY
hints: Wears an iconic straw hat given to him by Shanks.
Ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, turning his body to rubber.
Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates aiming to be King of the Pirates.

name: EREN
hints: Grew up inside Wall Maria in the Shiganshina District.
Swore to wipe out every single Titan after losing his mother.
Possesses the power of the Attack and Founding Titans.

name: REM
hints: Works as a maid at Roswaal's mansion alongside her twin sister.
Wields a spiked morningstar flail and has a single white horn.
Has blue hair and is fiercely devoted to Subaru.

name: SPIKE
hints: A laid-back bounty hunter cruising space aboard the Bebop.
Practices Jeet Kune Do and pilots a red Swordfish II fighter.
Has a cybernetic right eye and a fluffy dark green afro.

name: ASUNA
hints: Known as 'The Flash' for her blinding rapier speed.
Served as sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood Oath guild.
Fell in love with Kirito while trapped on Aincrad.

name: DENJI
hints: Worked off his father's yakuza debt by hunting devils with Pochita.
Pulls a starter cord on his chest to transform.
Joined Public Safety Division 4 mostly for good food and a normal life.

name: GOKU
hints: Sent to Earth as an infant to destroy it, but bumped his head.
Constantly seeks stronger opponents to fight.
Uses the Kamehameha and goes Super Saiyan.

name: NARUTO
hints: Loves eating Ichiraku Ramen and wears an orange jumpsuit.
Has the Nine-Tailed Fox sealed inside him.
Always yells 'Believe it!' and dreams of becoming Hokage.

name: SUBARU
hints: Was suddenly transported to another world outside a convenience store.
Wears an iconic black-and-orange tracksuit.
Possesses 'Return by Death', rewinding time whenever he dies.

name: RUDEUS
hints: Reincarnated into a fantasy world while keeping his past-life memories.
Trained in water magic by Roxy Migurdia as a child.
Earned the nickname 'Quagmire' during his time as an adventurer.

name: SATORU
hints: Covers his bright blue Six Eyes with a black blindfold or sunglasses.
Considered the strongest jujutsu sorcerer alive.
Uses the Limitless technique and Domain Expansion: Infinite Void.

name: EDWARD
hints: Lost his right arm and left leg in a failed human transmutation.
Can perform alchemy without drawing a transmutation circle.
Gets furious whenever anyone calls him short.

name: KILLUA
hints: Ran away from his famous family of elite assassins.
Best friends with Gon Freecss and loves chocolate robots.
Transmutes his aura into deadly electricity.

name: TANJIRO
hints: Carries his demon sister Nezuko inside a wooden box on his back.
Possesses an extraordinarily sharp sense of smell.
Wears a green-and-black checkered haori and uses Water & Sun Breathing.

name: LELOUCH
hints: An exiled Britannian prince attending Ashford Academy.
Leads the Black Knights under the masked identity 'Zero'.
Commands absolute obedience from anyone who makes eye contact with his left eye.

name: THORFINN
hints: Followed Askeladd's mercenary band for years seeking a fair duel.
Wields twin daggers in battle before swearing off violence.
Son of the legendary Jomsviking warrior Thors.

name: ALPHONSE
hints: His soul is bound to a giant hollow suit of steel armor.
Frequently mistaken for the 'Fullmetal Alchemist' instead of his brother.
Has a soft spot for stray kittens.

name: KAKASHI
hints: Known across nations as the 'Copy Ninja' who copied over 1,000 jutsu.
Always late to meetings and reads 'Make-Out Paradise' in public.
Led Team 7 and invented the Lightning Blade.

name: MIKASA
hints: Adopted by the Yeager family after her parents were murdered.
Wears a red scarf given to her by Eren.
An elite soldier of the Survey Corps with superhuman strength.

name: LEVI
hints: Known as humanity's strongest soldier.
Obsessively clean and short in stature.
Captain of the Survey Corps Special Operations Squad.

name: SAITAMA
hints: A hero who can defeat any enemy with a single punch.
Lost all his hair due to his intense training regimen.
Registered as a Class B hero and is obsessed with bargain sales.

name: KURAPIKA
hints: The last survivor of the Kurta clan.
His eyes turn scarlet when he becomes emotional.
Uses chains as his primary weapon and Nen ability.

name: FRIEREN
hints: An elf mage who outlived her party members.
Collects weird grimoires and spells.
Known for her extreme apathy and love for Zoltraak.

name: ZENITSU
hints: A cowardly demon slayer who only fights when unconscious.
Uses Thunder Breathing, specifically the first form.
Has a massive crush on Nezuko.

name: INOSUKE
hints: Raised by boars in the mountains.
Wears a boar's head mask and uses two jagged swords.
Uses Beast Breathing.

name: ITACHI
hints: A prodigy of the Konoha military police clan who joined the Akatsuki.
Wears a ring with the kanji for 'Vermilion' and uses crow clones.
Massacred his clan to protect his younger brother Sasuke.

name: ARMIN
hints: Childhood friend of Eren and Mikasa.
Known for his strategic intellect rather than combat skills.
Inherited the Colossal Titan.

name: HANGE
hints: Obsessed with researching Titans.
Becomes the 14th commander of the Survey Corps.
Often wears goggles and has messy hair.

name: SHANKS
hints: Captain of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Four Emperors.
Lost his left arm saving Luffy.
Known for his incredible Haki.

name: SANJI
hints: The Straw Hats' cook and a master of kicks.
Refuses to use his hands in battle to protect them for cooking.
Always swoons over beautiful women.

name: ZORO
hints: A master swordsman who uses the Three-Sword Style.
Has no sense of direction and often gets lost.
Wields the Enma sword.

name: NAMI
hints: The Straw Hats' navigator.
A skilled thief and cartographer.
Uses a staff to control the weather.

name: POWER
hints: The Blood Fiend.
Loves cats and fighting.
Has horns and a messy appearance.

name: MAKIMA
hints: A high-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter.
Controls people through her mysterious powers.
Has a distinct red-haired look and wears suits.

name: GOJO
hints: The strongest sorcerer.
Mentor to Yuji Itadori.
Wears a blindfold to protect others from his eyes.

name: YUJI
hints: Swallowed a cursed object to save his friends.
Host of the King of Curses.
Uses Divergent Fist and Black Flash.

name: NOBARA
hints: A first-year at Tokyo Jujutsu High.
Uses a hammer and nails as her weapons.
Extremely confident and fashionable.

name: BAKUGO
hints: Childhood rival of Izuku Midoriya who wants to surpass All Might.
Ignites nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms to create explosions.
Chose the hero name 'Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight'.

name: DEKU
hints: Born quirkless but inherited One For All.
Cries very easily.
Writes notes on every hero he meets.

name: SHOTO
hints: Son of the number two hero, Endeavor.
Has heterochromia and a scar on his left eye.
Can use both fire and ice.

name: MEGUMI
hints: A first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High with spiky dark hair.
Uses shadow puppets to summon shikigami like Divine Dogs.
Inherited the prized Ten Shadows Technique.

name: HISOKA
hints: A mysterious magician with a love for fighting strong opponents.
Uses Bungee Gum, which has the properties of both rubber and gum.
Often seen with a star and teardrop painted on his face.

name: FEITAN
hints: A member of the Phantom Troupe.
Specializes in torture and uses a sword.
His Nen ability is Pain Packer, which turns pain into heat.

name: MERUEM
hints: The King of the Chimera Ants.
Extremely powerful and ruthless.
Develops a bond with the blind girl Komugi.

name: NEZUKO
hints: Turned into a demon by Muzan.
Wears a bamboo muzzle to stop herself from biting people.
Can use Blood Demon Art: Exploding Blood.

name: YOR
hints: An assassin known as the Thorn Princess.
Pretends to be a housewife in a fake marriage.
Wields twin stilettos hidden in her dress.

name: ANYA
hints: A telepath adopted by Loid Forger.
Loves watching the anime 'Spy Wars'.
Has pink hair and wears a black hairband.

name: LOID
hints: A master spy codenamed Twilight.
Needs to form a fake family for Operation Strix.
Adopts a telepathic daughter and marries an assassin.

name: HIMMEL
hints: The hero who defeated the Demon King.
Was known for his charm and heroism.
Frieren only realized her feelings for him after his death.
